mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the matrix-gate fact lets Alloy construct a permitted operation whose (role,endpoint) cell is denied by the permission matrix — e.g., a compliance officer reading a clinical record. LeastPrivilege should catch this.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | some op.caller and op.caller.role = ComplianceOfficer and op.endpoint = EpGetRecord and op.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the clinician-care-team gate lets Alloy invent a permitted clinician access for a record on which the clinician has no active care-team membership — exactly the FR-004 violation the OwnershipBasedAccess assertion is meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBypass { some op: Operation | some op.caller and op.caller.role = Clinician and op.endpoint = EpGetRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctClinician = op.caller and m.ctRecord = op.targetRec) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the one-audit-per-authenticated-op fact lets the model invent an authenticated record-access operation with no matching audit entry, which violates FR-013/SC-001/SC-002.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some op: Operation | some op.caller and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.auditOp = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the note-justification fact lets a clinical note exist without a corresponding permitted append operation — modelling either a mutation that bypassed the API or a synthetic note appearing out of thin air, both forbidden by FR-012's append-only contract.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanNote { some n: ClinicalNote | (no op: Operation | op.opType = AppendOp and op.outcome = Permitted and op.caller = n.noteAuthor and op.targetRec = n.noteRecord) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the canonical-forbidden fact lets Alloy construct a denied operation whose response is observationally distinguishable from the byte-equivalent 403 envelope — exactly the existence-leak scenario FR-008/SC-003 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakyForbidden { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.response != CanonicalForbidden }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the authentication-boundary fact lets the model invent an unauthenticated operation that nonetheless reaches a Permitted outcome, violating FR-001's 'unauthenticated rejected before any record dereference' guarantee.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthPermitted { some op: Operation | no op.caller and op.outcome = Permitted }
